statement: let v := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ≤ X then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0; let F := fun (X H : ℕ) => (Finset.range (X+H+1)).sum (fun t => ((Finset.range H).sum (fun j => if j ≤ t then v X (t-j) else 0))^2); let C := fun (X h : ℕ) => (Finset.range (X+1)).sum (fun n => v X n * v X (n+h)); ∀ X : ℕ, F X 3-2*F X 2+F X 1 = 2*C X 2
